name: WDGG burnFrom without authorization burns the PancakeSwap pair reserve
summary: The WDGG implementation's burnFrom(from,value) debits any holder's balance with no allowance or caller check, and setWdgAddress lets anyone mark an address fee-exempt. The attacker exempted its contract, bought a little WDGG, burned nearly all WDGG held by the WDGG/USDT pair, called sync() and sold its WDGG into the inflated price. Two later actors repeated the pair burn.
notes: The age runs from the ProxyAdmin upgrade to the fifth implementation, the code the exploit ran; earlier implementations are irrelevant under rule 7.

Loss is the pair's USDT depletion per transaction net of USDT the exploiters paid in within the same transaction; the burned WDGG is not valued separately, as its value is what the USDT sales realised. The deployer's own burnFrom on its LP wallet is affiliated and not an exploit.
